shots.detail_en: CH's hand leaves the mop handle — the mop clatters against the pillar as he lets go
shots.sub: 旁白："那天上午，我把拖把放下了。"
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: CH threading through the packed crowd to the old chalkboard zone beside the giant screen, picking up half a stub of chalk with his back to the board
shots.sub: 散户乙："扫地的去黑板区干嘛？"
shots.speaker: 散户乙

shots.detail_en: CH taps three numbers onto the blackboard: 3.88, 3.66, 3.99
shots.sub: 长："开盘三点八八。最低三点六六。尾盘三点九九。"
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: The whole hall bursts into laughter at the sweeper writing price points
shots.sub: 散户甲："扫地工写点位？三点八八——连吉祥数都不会挑！"
shots.speaker: 散户甲

shots.detail_en: MANCANG doesn't laugh, gripping his pager white-knuckled
shots.sub: 满："……他说刀落三次，刀就真落了三次。"
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: RED looking up from behind the counter, her fingertip stopping on the ledger page
shots.sub: 红："小数点后两位——这不是蒙，这是账。"
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Opening bell: the flip board jumps alive and 联华码头's opening price flips out — 3.88
First hit: the board freezes on 3.88, the laughter cracking apart mid-roar
shots.sub: 旁白："第一个数，落地无声。"
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: CH draws out the one-minute-slow pocket watch while retail trader B forces a laugh beside him
shots.sub: 散户乙："蒙的！纯属巧合！" 长："最低还没到——你们还有一上午好笑。"
shots.speaker: 散户乙/CH

shots.detail_en: Morning compressed: mid-session swings / heads swinging between screen and blackboard / the chalk numbers glowing in the morning light
Afternoon: 联华码头 dives, a green bar plunging straight down
shots.speaker: 散户甲

shots.detail_en: The price tumbles digit by digit: 3.72 — 3.69 —
shots.sub: 散户乙："三块六七！三块六六——！"
shots.speaker: 散户乙

shots.detail_en: Second hit: the board freezes on 3.66, the first layer of silence — the loudest laugher goes mute first
MANCANG's pager slips from his hand and cracks on the floor; he doesn't even bend to pick it up
shots.sub: 满："三点六六……一个点不差……"
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: RED gazing through the crowd at the blackboard, her pen dropping onto the ledger
shots.sub: 红："他不追盘——他在等盘来见他。"
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: CH rubs his thumb across the cover of his father's notebook, then lifts his eyes to the closing tape
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: The closing tape flipping its last tiles, the whole hall rising on tiptoe
Burst point: the closing price freezes on 3.99 — the third hit; for the first time ever the whole hall falls silent enough to hear a pin drop
A thousand silent heads turning in one wave toward the white shirt at the blackboard, the crowd parting like cut water
Retail trader A breaks the silence first, the shout detonating as the crowd swivels to hunt for the sweeper
shots.sub: 散户甲："股——神——！" 人群："股神！股神在哪？！"
shots.speaker: 散户甲/散户群

shots.detail_en: Crisis hook: the roar suddenly sinks — a tuxedoed waiter glides through the crowd bearing a silver tray, every eye in the hall tracking him
On the tray a brand-new gold-stamped business card — XIONG's — one handwritten line on the back, the pair to the rain-stained old card in the locker
shots.sub: 字幕："点位说完了——该聊聊陆先生了。"

shots.detail_en: Black frame with the episode-end teaser card
shots.card: 他说出了点位，也说出了自己。
